i0-context.title: Load baseline context
i0-context.imperative: Load the #518 issue + comment, the physics packet + decision anchors, and the wiring seams (decoupled_longitudinal, session_braking, braking_view, car_prior). Record pass when loaded.

q1-scope.title: Scope boundary: focused core vs full 5-part program
q1-scope.imperative: The #518 comment lists 5 sub-tasks + the original C1 re-eval acceptance. Resolve whether the run is the focused core (wire estimator -> F_vehicle braking frontier -> ceiling, calibrate HPs, side-by-side retire decision, re-run C1 + verdict + lap-sampling sigma) with the scoreboard terrain-handle (item 4) routed to a follow-on; or the full program. Recommend focused core.

q2-contingency.title: C1 re-eval is verdict-producing, not GO-guaranteed
q2-contingency.imperative: Confirm the user accepts that the C1 re-eval produces a GO/CONTEXTUAL/NO-GO verdict on the recalibrated ceiling -- the deeper braking knee raises the ceiling (U should fall), but whether U lands <=1 and separates team/driver is an empirical outcome, not a guarantee.

q3-calibration.title: HP recalibration set size
q3-calibration.imperative: Resolve the multi-session/multi-driver HP calibration scope: a bounded representative set (the 3 scoreboard circuits + a few spanning braking severity / terrain, both cars) vs the full 2023-Q season. Recommend bounded representative (HPs are the filter noise model, not season pooling).

q4-sequencing.title: Side-by-side BEFORE wiring (retire as a decision gate)
q4-sequencing.imperative: Confirm the side-by-side (synthesis F_vehicle frontier vs clean_longitudinal_from_raw) runs as the FIRST substantive gate and gates the wiring decision -- no production wiring on an unratified input; one canonical path (no dual-input flag carried forward).

q5-wider-views.title: Wider-views: production-wire all longitudinal consumers, or wire braking + characterize the rest?
q5-wider-views.imperative: The user wants to understand how wiring the decoupled estimator changes the WIDER views (traction/power_drag/coast), not just braking. Resolve whether the run production-wires every longitudinal consumer onto the decoupled a_long (big blast radius) or wires braking canonically + characterizes (measured-not-wired) the parameter shift on the other views as a blast-radius report. Recommend wire-braking + characterize-the-rest (per #509 characterize-one-at-a-time).

q6-productize.title: Full productization of the wider views as the closing step
q6-productize.imperative: User: do full productization this issue, as the last step. After characterizing the wider views (traction/power_drag/coast) on the decoupled a_long, wire them onto it as the canonical longitudinal source -- single path, MEASURED-not-wired retired. Any view the characterization shows REGRESSING is surfaced as a fix-or-hold decision, not blindly wired.

consolidation.verdict: RESOLVED: full-program #518 — calibrate (full season) → side-by-side gates braking wiring → wire braking F_vehicle into ceiling → terrain scoreboard handle → re-run C1 + lap-σ + verdict → characterize wider views → productize wider views (regressions surfaced). Problem statement at PROBLEM_STATEMENT.md.
